mapper.sql: EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role global_ur JOIN sys_role global_r ON global_r.id = global_ur.role_id AND global_r.status = 'active' JOIN sys_role_permission global_rp ON global_rp.role_id = global_r.id JOIN sys_permission global_p ON global_p.id = global_rp.permission_id AND global_p.status = 'active' WHERE global_ur.user_id = #{userId} AND global_r.role_key = 'platform_admin' AND global_ur.scope_type = 'global' AND global_ur.scope_id = '*' AND global_p.permission_key = 'audit.read' ) OR ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_resource_scope any_scope WHERE any_scope.audit_id = al.id) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM audit_resource_scope scope_row WHERE scope_row.audit_id = al.id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 'active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.status = 'active' WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.permission_key = 'audit.read' AND ur.scope_type = scope_row.scope_type AND ur.scope_id = scope_row.scope_id ) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log al WHERE

SELECT al.id, al.occurred_at, al.actor_type, al.action, al.resource_type, al.resource_id, al.request_id, al.outcome FROM audit_log al WHERE ORDER BY al.occurred_at DESC, al.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
